pages.text: Wire antennas are strung between $(item)wire holders$(): baluns, $(item)antenna poles$() and $(item)antenna connectors$(). Right click one holder with $(item)antenna wire$(), then another, and a wire runs between them. A wire must end on a holder or it falls down.
Lengths are in blocks, one block is a metre. A $(thing)quarter wave$() is about:$(li)80 m band: 20 blocks$(li)40 m band: 10$(li)20 m band: 5$(li)10 m band: 3$(br)Every block off costs 0.5 SWR.
pages.title: How long?

pages.text: Anything strung on a balun that is not a proper antenna becomes an $(thing)Improvised$() antenna: it works, with an SWR that grows the further it is from a clean shape. Right click a balun to see what it thinks it is.
pages.title: Improvised
